positions.commentary: The speaker mentions Tesla as an example of a contentious stock where analysts are unlikely to come out and say it is overrated or a sell.
Henry Blasjo was a sell-side analyst who was very bullish on Amazon, putting lofty price targets on the stock.

thesis: This episode argues that sell-side analysts often face significant pressure and social constraints when covering contentious stocks like Tesla, making it unlikely they will publicly express negative views even if they believe the stock is overrated. In contrast, the discussion highlights that analysts like Henry Blasjo were able to be very bullish on Amazon by setting lofty price targets, suggesting a more favorable environment for positive conviction in that specific case.
